items.title_zh: 豆包输入法Windows版上线，一年补齐全平台：AI输入法要变天了？
items.title_en: Doubao Input Method Launches Windows Version, Completing Full-Platform Coverage
items.summary_zh: 豆包输入法Windows版上线，一年补齐全平台：AI输入法要变天了？ Sohu
items.summary_en: Doubao Input Method has launched its Windows version, completing full-platform coverage from mobile to desktop in about a year. This desktop entry puts Doubao in direct competition with established input methods and could reshape the AI input method market. Actual user experience and market impact are yet to be seen.
items.why_zh: 豆包输入法补齐桌面端，意味着AI输入法进入全平台阶段，传统输入法市场或迎来变数。
items.why_en: The Windows release signals a full-platform push for AI input methods, potentially transforming the input method market.

items.title_zh: 曹操出行携手豆包推出AI打车，北京、杭州、苏州首批上线
items.title_en: Cao Cao Mobility Partners with Doubao for AI Ride-Hailing, Launching in Beijing, Hangzhou, Suzhou
items.summary_zh: 曹操出行携手豆包推出AI打车，北京、杭州、苏州首批上线 东方财富
items.summary_en: Cao Cao Mobility has joined forces with Doubao to launch an AI-powered ride-hailing service in Beijing, Hangzhou, and Suzhou. While specific features remain undisclosed, the partnership marks an early attempt to integrate an AI assistant into a major ride-hailing app. The pilot could influence the future direction of AI in transportation.
items.why_zh: 这是AI助手与网约车平台的标志性合作，让AI打车从概念进入现实。
items.why_en: A flagship collaboration that brings AI assistants into ride-hailing, making AI-powered transportation a practical reality.

items.title_zh: 曹操出行携手豆包推出AI打车，北京杭州苏州首批上线服务
items.title_en: Cao Cao Mobility and Doubao Launch AI Ride-Hailing with Initial Service in Beijing, Hangzhou, Suzhou
items.summary_zh: 曹操出行携手豆包推出AI打车，北京杭州苏州首批上线服务 Sohu
items.summary_en: Cao Cao Mobility and Doubao have officially launched an AI ride-hailing service in Beijing, Hangzhou, and Suzhou. The service embeds Doubao's AI capabilities into the hailing platform, though users are still learning how it works. Results from these cities may decide the future rollout of AI ride-hailing.
items.why_zh: 豆包AI深入打车场景，展现了大模型在本地生活服务中的落地潜力。
items.why_en: This collaboration shows how large-model AI is moving into everyday ride-hailing services.

items.title_zh: AutoKD：自主知识发现，让AI接管科学研究？
items.title_en: AutoKD: Autonomous Knowledge Discovery
items.summary_zh: 新近公布的arXiv论文《AutoKD：自主知识发现》提出了一种面向数据密集型领域的多智能体发现框架。作者指出，科学发现目前受限于人类处理数据的带宽，而现有基于大语言模型的多智能体系统只能部分自动化研究流程，既无法自动验证假设，运行之间也相互独立，缺少知识积累。AutoKD的目标是让多个智能体协作，在自动化假设生成与验证上更进一步，并支持发现结果持续累积。由于论文摘要没有披露完整方法细节，其实际机制与效果仍需查阅全文。若AutoKD可靠，AI或能从“辅助分析”走向“主导发现”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.06366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific discovery in data-rich domains is currently constrained by human bandwidth: the growth in the volume and complexity of real-world data far outpaces the rate at which researchers can read, reason, and synthesize. Recent LLM-based multi-agent systems have begun to automate portions of the research cycle, but they target hypothesis generation in settings where validation cannot itself be automated, and each run is one-shot, with no mechanism for findings to accumulate or steer subsequent inquiry. This paper introduces AutoKD, a multi-agen…
items.why_zh: 这项研究试图让AI系统实现知识积累与自主验证，有望突破科学发现中人类精力的瓶颈。
items.why_en: AutoKD could lift the human bandwidth limit on science by enabling AI to autonomously discover and accumulate knowledge.

items.title_zh: SSP-DMGTimeNet：让车辆队列轨迹预测既准确又符合物理规律
items.title_en: SSP-DMGTimeNet: Physics-Constrained Learning for Spatiotemporal Trajectory Prediction of Vehicle Platoons
items.summary_zh: 这篇arXiv论文提出SSP-DMGTimeNet，一个面向车辆队列时空轨迹预测的物理约束学习框架。现有跟车预测方法大多只优化轨迹数值精度，不考虑预测出的扰动沿队列传播时是否符合真实交通动力学，因而可能出现“误差小却不稳定”的问题。新模型结合多尺度时间表示和跨车交互特征，以捕捉复杂的队列动态，并引入与扰动传播相关的约束，使预测结果在数值上准确、在物理上可信。该思路对车辆队列稳定性分析、自动驾驶决策评估均有参考价值。完整实验结果尚未在摘要中给出，有待阅读论文正文。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.06961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing car-following prediction methods mainly optimize trajectory accuracy, while rarely considering whether predicted disturbances propagate realistically along a vehicle platoon. This limitation may lead to accurate but string-unstable predictions. We propose SSP-DMGTimeNet, a physics-constrained learning framework for spatiotemporal trajectory prediction of vehicle platoons. The model combines multi-scale temporal representations with cross-vehicle interaction features to capture complex and time-varying platoon dynamics. A propagation-dela…
items.why_zh: 把“扰动传播是否合理”纳入预测目标，让轨迹预测从纯数字拟合迈向物理可解释，对队列安全至关重要。
items.why_en: It enforces physical consistency in propagation, making trajectory predictions not just accurate but reliable for platoon safety.

items.title_zh: 广告排序的瓶颈是人力？A-MLE试图用AI代理自动化机器学习探索
items.title_en: Agentic ML Exploration (A-MLE) for Ads Ranking
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文指出，现代工业广告排序系统的瓶颈已不再是模型容量或训练算力，而是人类工程师的研发迭代速度。在典型排序系统中，面对大量数据、架构和基础设施各不相同的模型，一个优化点从研究到上线需要资深工程师耗费数天至数周。为了突破这一瓶颈，论文提出A-MLE（智能体式机器学习探索），让AI代理承担研究、实现、训练、调试、评估等环节中的重复性工作，以提升实验吞吐量。该方法或有潜力大幅缩短广告模型的优化周期，并推广到其他大规模机器学习场景。具体效果待实验数据支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.08248v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern industrial ads ranking stacks are increasingly bottlenecked not by model capacity or training compute, but by the throughput of human ML iteration - the cycles of research, implementation, training, debugging, evaluation, and launch required to surface a single statistically significant improvement. A typical ranking stack contains numerous differentiated models with heterogeneous data, architectures, and infrastructure constraints, and each cycle takes days to weeks of senior engineer attention per model. As a result, techniques that have…
items.why_zh: 首次将AI代理引入机器学习研发流水线，可能彻底改变工业界模型迭代的方式。
items.why_en: A-MLE applies AI agents to machine learning R&D itself, potentially removing a key human bottleneck in model iteration.

items.title_zh: API基准分数与聊天界面表现脱节，ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini遭审计
items.title_en: API Benchmark Scores Do Not Reliably Transfer to Chatbot Interfaces
items.summary_zh: 一项针对ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini的审计研究发现，模型通过API获得的基准分数，并不能可靠反映其在聊天机器人界面中的真实表现。研究横跨7个系统、9个基准，覆盖通用能力、社会偏见和谄媚行为。结果显示，API与界面之间存在系统性的准确性和一致性差异，说明不同访问方式会显著影响模型输出。该结论意味着，基准分数可能在购买决策和公众信任中被错误使用。它建议在部署评估中更多考虑实际接口的差异，而不是只看某个标准API分数。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.08861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmark scores are a central currency in model releases: they inform purchasing decisions, shape public trust, and influence policy. Yet, a key assumption underlying benchmark scores is that the model performance measured through APIs faithfully reflects the behavior of deployed systems. We challenge this assumption by auditing ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across seven systems and nine benchmarks spanning general capability, social bias, and sycophancy. We find systematic API--interface differences in both accuracy and consistency. On average, A…
items.why_zh: 该研究动摇了“API基准=模型真实水平”的行业默认，影响评测、选型与监管。
items.why_en: By proving API scores don't always reflect chatbot performance, this research challenges how benchmarks are used in purchasing and policy.

items.title_zh: 针对长上下文LLM解码的KV缓存量化：适配片上NVM存储
items.title_en: Interface-Aware KV Cache Quantization for Dense On-Chip NVM in Long-Context LLM Decoding
items.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦长上下文大语言模型解码时KV缓存带来的内存瓶颈。解码每一步都要完整读取KV缓存，因此系统常常受限于内存带宽。作者提出一种接口感知的量化方案，将量化后的KV缓存保存在片上密集非易失性存储器（NVM）中，以避免高成本片外传输。此前主流方法多面向GPU内存设计：KIVI附加分组元数据，会使KV缓存增大约25%；KVQuant保留的稀疏全精度异常值难以放入密集阵列。该研究的目标是设计能利用NVM特性的量化表示，并兼顾存储密度与准确性。论文摘要未提供完整评估，更多细节需阅读原文。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05764v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck in long-context large language model (LLM) decoding: every step reads it entirely, so decoding is memory-bandwidth bound. Holding a quantized KV cache in dense on-chip non-volatile memory (NVM) removes the off-chip transfer. Existing KV quantization methods, however, were designed for GPU-style memory systems: KIVI attaches per-group metadata, adding about 25% to the stored KV cache; KVQuant keeps sparse full-precision outliers that a dense array cannot hold in place. This paper examine…
items.why_zh: 针对新型存储介质重新设计KV缓存量化，有望化解长上下文大模型推理的内存墙问题。
items.why_en: This storage-aware quantization could break the memory bottleneck that limits long-context LLM decoding.

items.title_zh: ExpertLens：可视化嵌入空间，为MoE增强检索器提供事后可解释性
items.title_en: ExpertLens: Visualizing Embedding Spaces for Post-Hoc Explainability in MoE Enhanced Retrievers
items.summary_zh: 神经检索模型（包括稠密检索器）在信息检索中被广泛采用，虽性能优异，但作为黑箱模型，其排序决策难以解释。现有对神经排序器的事后解释方法多集中于特征级归因，难以捕捉所学嵌入空间的复杂性。为此，论文提出 ExpertLens，一个面向混合专家（MoE）增强检索器的事后可解释性框架，以可视化嵌入空间的方式揭示模型行为。由于摘要原文截断，具体实现细节和实验效果未进一步披露。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.06155v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural models, including dense retrievers, have been widely adopted in Information Retrieval (IR), often delivering state-of-the-art performance. Despite their effectiveness, these models operate as black boxes, limiting the interpretability of their ranking decisions. Existing post-hoc explainability methods for neural rankers primarily focus on feature-level attributions, which can be insufficient to capture the complexity of learned embedding spaces. In this work, we propose ExpertLens, a post-hoc explainability framework for Mixture-of-Expe…
items.why_zh: 它为MoE增强的稠密检索器提供了一种从嵌入空间层面进行事后解释的新途径，有助于理解模型的排序依据。
items.why_en: It offers a new post-hoc explanation route at the embedding-space level for MoE-enhanced neural retrievers.

items.title_zh: Ambient @ EgoProactive 2026：基于视觉接地监督的主动式自我中心辅助
items.title_en: Ambient @ EgoProactive 2026 : Proactive Egocentric Assistance with Visually Grounded Supervision
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍作者提交至ECCV 2026可穿戴AI挑战赛EgoProactive赛道的方案，该方案在大模型分组中获得第一名，在另一分组中获得第二名。方法上有两点关键设计：一是将任务建模为针对特定token（如yes/no）的判别式预测，而非自由文本生成，使宏平均F1提升0.249、G-mean提升0.30；二是由于标注数据仅限官方验证集，他们使用可调用工具的视频智能体检查每个片段，自动生成额外监督信号。这展示了视觉接地监督与高效判别式解码相结合在主动自我中心辅助中的应用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.07099v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present our submission to the EgoProactive track of the ECCV 2026 Wearable AI Challenge, which ranked first in the large-model division and second in the or $silent$, the model predicts yes or no, and we derive the decision from the renormalised probabilities of these two tokens. This formulation improved macro-F1 by 0.249 and G-mean by 0.30 over free-form generation. Second, because labelled data were limited to the released validation set, we generated additional supervision using a tool-calling video agent that inspects each clip and assi…
items.why_zh: 该方案证明了在可穿戴AI场景中，将多模态输入转化为判别式token预测并辅以视频智能体自动生成监督，可取得领先性能。
items.why_en: It shows that token-level discriminative prediction plus auto-generated visual supervision can achieve top performance in egocentric proactive assistance.

items.title_zh: 你的智能体说“行”：解读超越单笔交易的对抗性市场行为
items.title_en: Your Agent Says Yes: Interpreting Adversarial Market Behavior Beyond Individual Transactions
items.summary_zh: 交易层面的局部控制只能决定单个金融请求是否放行，但市场行为可能跨消息、跨智能体、跨资产与跨时间分布。本文在一个由10个角色化语言模型智能体构成的虚拟交易所中研究这一解释差距。这些智能体被赋予规定的对抗性角色，可通信、交易参考资产和期货、发布代币并管理集中流动性池。作者分析了在两条时间盲态每小时回放路径下的8条72周期轨迹，并启用了运行方钱包策略，以观察超出单笔交易的市场行为。该研究旨在揭示各类跨交易、跨智能体对抗行为模式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.07675v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Transaction-local controls answer whether one financial request may proceed, but market behavior can be distributed across messages, agents, assets, and time. We study this interpretation gap in a virtual exchange populated by ten role-conditioned language-model agents. The agents communicate, trade reference assets and futures, launch tokens, and manage concentrated-liquidity pools under prescriptive adversarial roles. We analyze eight 72-cycle trajectories across two time-blinded hourly replay paths, with a runner-side wallet policy enabled o…
items.why_zh: 若只看单笔交易批准，容易漏掉跨智能体、跨时间协作的异常市场行为；该研究为多智能体金融市场的系统性风险识别提供了实验框架。
items.why_en: It highlights limits of trade-level monitoring and offers a multi-agent virtual market setup for studying distributed adversarial behavior.

items.title_zh: 迈向具身空地协同目标搜索：基准、数据集与智能体方法
items.title_en: Towards Embodied Air-Ground Cooperative Object Search: Benchmark, Dataset and Agentic Method
items.summary_zh: 空地协同目标搜索（AGOS）是一项发生在城市环境的具身任务，要求无人机（UAV）与无人车（UGV）依据多视角视觉参考，共同搜索并确认指定目标车辆。为研究这一较少被探索的问题，论文提出 AGOS-Bench，这是首个专门评估通用视觉语言模型（VLM）能否通过无人机与地面车协作，将空中发现与地面验证结合起来完成目标的基准。作者还提供了配套的 AGOS-Dataset 数据集，并给出了相应的智能体方法。该工作为具身空地协同搜索研究奠定了评测基础和实验条件。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.08402v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Air-Ground Object Search (AGOS) in urban environments is a challenging embodied task, which requires an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and an Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) to jointly search for and verify a specified target vehicle from multi-view visual references. To study this underexplored problem, we introduce AGOS-Bench, the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can integrate aerial discoveries and ground-level verification through UAV-UGV cooperation. We further provide AGOS-Dataset…
items.why_zh: 该基准填补了通用VLM在空地异构机器人协同搜索场景中的评测空白，可推动具身智能体在真实城市任务中的应用研究。
items.why_en: It fills a gap in benchmarking VLMs for heterogeneous air-ground cooperative search, enabling progress in embodied AI.

items.title_zh: SequenceO1：利用低秩缓存实现端到端10万级超长序列推荐建模
items.title_en: SequenceO1: End-to-End Ultra-Long (100K) Sequence Modeling in Recommendation with Low-Rank Caching
items.summary_zh: 长期用户行为建模是序列推荐与十亿级工业推荐系统的核心，但生产环境中的排序模型受延迟、内存、通信和训练吞吐量等严格约束。当序列长度达到10万（100K）时，挑战已不止于注意力机制复杂度：原始序列特征在训练和在线服务期间需要被存储、传输和反复处理。现有方法通常采用历史截断、多阶段行为检索、压缩终生历史或在训练中缩短序列等近似方案。论文提出 SequenceO1，以端到端方式建模100K超长序列，并借助低秩缓存降低存储和计算开销。该工作为工业级超长行为序列建模提供了新的解决方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.08443v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modeling long-term user behavior is central to sequential recommendation and billion-scale industrial recommender systems, yet production ranking models operate under strict latency, memory, communication, and training-throughput constraints. At the 100K scale, the challenge extends beyond attention complexity: raw sequence features must be stored, transferred, and repeatedly processed during training and online serving. Existing approaches based on history truncation, multi-stage behavior retrieval, compressed lifelong histories, or train-shor…
items.why_zh: 它主攻超长行为序列（100K）在推荐系统中的实际部署瓶颈，有望让模型真正利用完整历史而非截断/压缩后的近似信息。
items.why_en: It targets the practical bottlenecks of storing and transferring 100K-long histories, making ultra-long sequence modeling viable in production recommenders.

items.title_zh: 这不再是我的代码
items.title_en: It Is Not My Code Anymore
items.summary_zh: AI辅助编程带来了新的疑问：代码由谁生成、谁对其有归属感、出错时谁承担责任。这篇研究笔记通过一个虚构的注册失败案例和选择性文献梳理，考察了这些区分。作者指出，即使找到一段有缺陷表达式的生成者，也不能就此确定审查者、发布决策者或服务运营者的职责；集体所有权同样无法自动划定这些义务。讨论进一步转向质量工程技术，探讨它如何补充责任分配机制。该文提醒我们，AI时代代码问责不能只追溯到“谁写了这一行”，而应审视整个开发与发布链条中的角色分工。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09022v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI-assisted programming raises distinct questions about who produces code, who feels ownership of it, and who is responsible when it fails. This research note examines these distinctions through a hypothetical enrollment failure and a selective reading of the literature. Identifying the producer of a defective expression does not, by itself, determine the duties of reviewers, release decision-makers, or service operators. Collective ownership likewise leaves those duties to be specified. The discussion then considers how quality engineering can…
items.why_zh: 它厘清了AI辅助编程中的责任冗余与空白：确定代码出处并不等于确定谁该负责，提示流程各环节需要明确分工。
items.why_en: It clarifies why AI-assisted coding requires a process-level accountability framework rather than simply attributing code to its generator.

items.title_zh: 在持续多轮对抗压力下测量大语言模型的谄媚行为
items.title_en: Measuring LLM Sycophancy under Sustained Multi-Turn Pressure
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）面对用户反驳时可能放弃原本正确的立场，这一失败模式被称为“谄媚”（sycophancy）。现有评测通常使用简短且预设好的对话，因而难以暴露在持续、自适应分歧中才出现的缺陷。为此，作者引入 SPINE 基准：由一个 LLM 代理扮演持续犯错但固执的用户，在最多25轮对话中自适应地挑战目标模型。他们使用100个错误预设问题和100个不道德查询，评估了4个生产级系统和3个Olmo3-7b变体。SPINE 为衡量模型在长期对抗压力下的观点稳定性提供了更严格的测试方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.09090v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) may abandon correct positions when users push back, exhibiting a failure mode known as sycophancy. Existing evaluations typically use short, pre-specified conversations and may therefore miss failures that emerge under sustained, adaptive disagreement. We introduce SPINE, a benchmark in which an LLM proxy plays a persistent but mistaken user and adaptively challenges a target model for up to 25 turns. We evaluate four production systems and three Olmo3-7b variants on 100 false-presupposition and 100 unethical-query…
items.why_zh: 不同于一次性简短测试，该基准把“持续多轮唱反调”作为核心压力条件，能更真实地暴露聊天中模型见风使舵的问题。
items.why_en: It captures sycophancy failures that only appear under sustained adaptive user pressure, making it a more realistic reliability test for LLMs.

items.title_zh: UniMoMo：基于专家合并的大规模推荐模型MoE加速方法
items.title_en: UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models
items.summary_zh: 稀疏混合专家（MoE）层通过条件计算扩大了推荐模型容量，但训练好的模型仍需要保存并路由其全部专家，部署负担较重。作者研究这样一个部署问题：能否在显式专家预算下，将已有MoE checkpoint转换为更小的标准MoE，同时无需增加专门用于压缩的在线模块？为此，他们提出 UniMoMo，一种将训练后压缩形式化为带约束图粗化问题的框架。与依靠参数距离不同，UniMoMo对专家进行分组和合并，从图结构角度实现压缩。该方法有助于在保持模型效果的同时减少推理开销，加速大模型推荐系统的服务部署。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.08627v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers expand recommendation capacity through conditional computation, yet a trained checkpoint still stores and routes over its full expert bank. We study a deployment problem: convert that checkpoint to a smaller standard MoE under an explicit expert budget, without adding a compression-specific online module. To address this, we introduce UniMoMo, a post-training compression framework formulated as a constrained graph coarsening problem. Rather than relying on parameter distance, UniMoMo groups experts based…
items.why_zh: 它为MoE推荐模型的快速部署提供了一种训练后压缩路径，同时支持按专家数量预算控制模型规模，无需改动在线推理结构。
items.why_en: It enables efficient post-training compression of MoE-based recommenders while strictly respecting expert budgets and avoiding extra online components.

items.title_zh: 从语境到价值：抽象论证中的语境相关击败
items.title_en: From Contexts to Values: Context-Dependent Defeat in Abstract Argumentation
items.summary_zh: 在基于价值的论证中，通常由听众的价值排序决定哪些攻击能够成为有效的“击败”。但在许多现实场景中，决定性因素并非听众，而是语境或环境：同一个攻击在某一程序阶段或法规下可能有效，在另一语境下却可能无效。为此，作者提出上下文相关论证框架（CDAFs），它以一个攻击关系为基础，并通过一个“击败函数”按上下文切换各攻击的开关，从而让每个上下文都诱导出一个标准的Dung框架。该模型把语境因素内化为论证框架的一部分，为描述程序阶段、规则变动等对论证结论的影响提供了直接的形式化工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15536v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In value-based argumentation, an audience's ordering of values decides which attacks succeed as defeats. In many settings the deciding factor is not the audience but the circumstances: the same attack may succeed at one procedural stage, or under one regulation, and fail at another. Context-dependent argumentation frameworks (CDAFs), a model we recently introduced, capture this directly: one attack relation and a defeat function that switches each attack on or off per context, so every context induces an ordinary Dung framework. This raises a…
items.why_zh: 该研究将语境因素系统纳入抽象论证框架，更贴近法律、审议等依赖程序情境的论证场景。
items.why_en: This work makes context a first-class citizen in abstract argumentation, enabling more realistic modeling of procedural and regulatory effects on argumentation.

items.title_zh: 扩展TotalSegmentator：从CT与MR图像预测患者和采集特征
items.title_en: Extending TotalSegmentator: Predicting Patient and Acquisition Characteristics from CT and MR Images
items.summary_zh: 患者基本信息和影像采集元数据对临床决策、图像质量控制和自动化研究流程十分重要，但影像档案中这些信息常会缺失或不准确。为此，本研究旨在开发并评估一种快速开源模型，直接从CT和MR图像预测患者特征和采集参数。研究者分别针对CT和MR训练了3D ResNet-10集成模型，使用了2011至2025年间采集的57,291次CT检查和43,200次MR检查数据。模型可预测体重、身高、年龄、性别、是否使用对比剂等属性。该工作承继TotalSegmentator的思路，尝试在元数据缺失时从图像本身自动重建关键信息。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.29348v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Background: Patient details and acquisition metadata are important for clinical decisions, image quality control, and automated research pipelines, but may be missing or unreliable in imaging archives. Purpose: To develop and evaluate a fast open-source model that predicts patient and acquisition characteristics directly from CT and MR images. Materials and Methods: Separate 3D ResNet-10 ensembles for CT and MR were trained on 57,291 and 43,200 clinical examinations acquired from 2011 to 2025. Both predicted weight, height, age, sex, contrast…
items.why_zh: 该模型能在影像元数据缺失时直接从图像推断关键信息，为临床决策和影像质量控制提供开源兜底方案。
items.why_en: It offers an open-source fallback for recovering patient and acquisition metadata from images, with broad utility in clinical and research settings.

items.title_zh: PiMRef：借助知识库不变量推导不断演变的鱼叉式钓鱼邮件
items.title_en: PiMRef: Deducing Ever-evolving Spear-phishing Emails with Knowledge Base Invariants
items.summary_zh: 钓鱼邮件是网络犯罪杀伤链中的关键一环，因为受害者邮箱账户可达性高，且发起攻击的成本很低。不断演变的钓鱼手法，使传统基于规则和特征工程的检测器在攻防拉锯中常常处于被动。本研究展示，大型语言模型（LLM）能够被有效利用来生成基于个人资料的鱼叉式钓鱼邮件，从而威胁现有主要的钓鱼检测范式。该发现提示，LLM可能成为定制化社工攻击的推手，防御方需要研究对应的检测与防护新机制。研究名称“PiMRef”暗示用知识库不变量来识别此类攻击，但具体算法细节未见摘要明确说明。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.15393v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Phishing email is a critical step in the cybercrime kill chain due to the high reachability of victims' email accounts and the low cost of launching phishing campaigns. This ever-evolving nature of phishing emails makes traditional rule-based and feature-engineering-based phishing email detectors fight an uphill battle in the cat-and-mouse game of defense and attack. In this work, we show that, large language models (LLMs) can be effectively exploited to generate profile-grounded spear-phishing, compromising major paradigms of phishing…
items.why_zh: 该研究提醒人们，LLM可被滥用制作高拟真的鱼叉式钓鱼邮件，对既有检测范式构成新的安全威胁。
items.why_en: It underscores that LLMs can be weaponized for tailored spear-phishing, urging new defenses beyond traditional detection paradigms.

items.title_zh: 知识引导的视觉-语言推理用于图像城市洪涝水深估计
items.title_en: Knowledge-Guided Vision-Language Inference for Image-Based Urban Flood Depth Estimation
items.summary_zh: 城市内涝期间，及时估算洪水水深有助于评估道路可达性和指导应急响应。传统的监督视觉方法通常依赖大量标注数据，而近年来基础视觉-语言模型虽然能进行灵活视觉推理，但在度量级水深估计上容易产生不一致的较大误差。针对这一问题，论文提出FloodVision框架，将通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）与领域知识库FloodKG结合，以实现从单张RGB图像对洪水深度的知识引导估计。通过把水文领域知识嵌入推理过程，FloodVision旨在提升单图像水深估计的准确性和可靠性，降低对外部标注的依赖。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2509.04772v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Timely floodwater depth estimates support road accessibility assessment and emergency response during urban flooding. Supervised vision methods often require extensive labeled datasets, while recent foundation vision-language models (VLMs) offer flexible visual reasoning but can inconsistently yield large errors in metric depth estimation. This paper proposes FloodVision, a knowledge-guided framework for estimating flood depth from a single RGB image. FloodVision integrates a general-purpose VLM with FloodKG, a domain knowledge base enc…
items.why_zh: 该框架将领域知识注入视觉-语言模型，为城市洪涝的快速水深评估提供了一条降低标注依赖并提升可靠性的可行路径。
items.why_en: It shows how injecting domain knowledge into a VLM can make metric flood-depth estimation from everyday images more reliable and less dependent on labeled datasets.

items.title_zh: 融合序列基序与泛基因组特征：基于可解释轻量级1D CNN-XGBoost集成的耐药性预测
items.title_en: Fusing Sequence Motifs and Pan-Genomic Features: Antimicrobial Resistance Prediction using an Explainable Lightweight 1D CNN-XGBoost Ensemble
items.summary_zh: 抗生素耐药性（AMR）已成为日益严峻的全球健康危机。尽管基因组测序可帮助快速预测耐药表型，但现有计算方法仍有不足：普通机器学习通常把基因组当作无序特征集合，忽视单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）的上下文信息；而Transformer等前沿序列模型又往往需要海量数据和昂贵算力，不适用于该领域常见的中等规模数据集。为此，该研究提出一种可解释的轻量级1D卷积神经网络（CNN）与XGBoost相结合的集成模型，融合序列基序与泛基因组特征来预测耐药性。它试图在捕捉序列局部上下文的同时保持较低计算成本，并为临床和科研提供可解释的预测结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2509.23552v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) is a rapidly escalating global health crisis. While genomic sequencing enables rapid prediction of resistance phenotypes, current computational methods have limitations. Standard machine learning models treat the genome as an unordered collection of features, ignoring the sequential context of Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms (SNPs). State-of-the-art sequence models like Transformers are often too data-hungry and computationally expensive for the moderately sized datasets that are typical in this domain. To…
items.why_zh: 该研究提供了一种高性价比且可解释的耐药性预测方案，在中等规模基因组数据上比数据饥渴的大模型更切实际。
items.why_en: It addresses the efficiency and interpretability gap in AMR prediction, offering a practical alternative for typical genome datasets where Transformers are too costly.

items.title_zh: 揭示隐藏威胁：用分形触发器增强联邦学习中分布式后门攻击的隐蔽性
items.title_en: Unveiling Hidden Threats: Using Fractal Triggers to Boost Stealthiness of Distributed Backdoor Attacks in Federated Learning
items.summary_zh: 联邦学习中的传统分布式后门攻击（DBA）通过将全局触发器拆分成若干子触发器来提升隐蔽性，但这种方式需要更多中毒数据才能维持攻击强度，反而可能增加暴露风险。为了弥补这一缺陷，论文提出一种新方法FTDBA（分形触发分布式后门攻击），利用分形的自相似性增强子触发器的特征强度，从而在显著降低所需中毒数据量的前提下维持攻击力度。该方法展示了一种更隐蔽、更难察觉的后门攻击路径，对联邦学习中现有的安全防护构成新的潜在威胁。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2511.09252v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Traditional distributed backdoor attacks (DBA) in federated learning improve stealthiness by decomposing global triggers into sub-triggers, which however requires more poisoned data to maintian the attck strength and hence increases the exposure risk. To overcome this defect, This paper proposes a novel method, namely Fractal-Triggerred Distributed Backdoor Attack (FTDBA), which leverages the self-similarity of fractals to enhance the feature strength of sub-triggers and hence significantly reduce the required poisoning volume for the s…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了一种仅凭更少中毒样本便可保持威力的分布式后门攻击设计，提醒联邦学习防御者注意此类低数据依赖威胁。
items.why_en: It uncovers a fractal-based trigger method that boosts attack stealth with far fewer poisoned samples, presenting an important new threat model for federated learning.

items.title_zh: AI交通流模式与土地利用交互的时空异质性：多模式城市流动的GeoAI分析
items.title_en: Spatiotemporal Heterogeneity of AI-Driven Traffic Flow Patterns and Land Use Interaction: A GeoAI-Based Analysis of Multimodal Urban Mobility
items.summary_zh: 城市交通流的运行受土地利用配置与时空异质性出行需求之间复杂非线性交互的支配。常规的全局回归和时间序列模型难以同时捕捉多种出行模式下的多尺度动态。该研究提出一个GeoAI混合分析框架，顺序集成多尺度地理加权回归（MGWR）、随机森林（RF）和时空图卷积网络（ST-GCN），用于建模多模式城市交通流的时空异质性及其与土地利用的交互。通过结合空间统计与深度学习，该框架能够探索不同尺度下交通流与城市功能结构的关系，为城市规划和智能交通管理提供分析支持。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.05581v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Urban traffic flow is governed by the complex, nonlinear interaction between land use configuration and spatiotemporally heterogeneous mobility demand. Conventional global regression and time-series models cannot simultaneously capture these multi-scale dynamics across multiple travel modes. This study proposes a GeoAI Hybrid analytical framework that sequentially integrates Multiscale Geographically Weighted Regression (MGWR), Random Forest (RF), and Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (ST-GCN) to model the spatiotemporal hete…
items.why_zh: 该研究为解析多模式城市交通流与土地利用之间的多尺度时空耦合提供了一种GeoAI分析范式，有利于智能城市决策。
items.why_en: It offers a hybrid GeoAI framework for untangling the multi-scale spatiotemporal coupling between multimodal mobility and land use, which can inform urban planning and traffic management.

items.title_zh: 服从还是理性：大型语言模型中的推理可控性
items.title_en: Compliance vs. Sensibility: On the Reasoning Controllability in Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力被认为源于预训练数据中的共享推理模式，并且能通过思维链（CoT）进一步激发。然而，归纳、演绎、溯因等基本推理模式能否与具体问题实例相分离，这一问题直接关系到模型的可控性。本文首次通过“推理冲突”这一视角系统探究该问题，聚焦参数化知识与上下文信息之间的显式张力。该研究有助于揭示用户的提示或上下文能否把模型的推理拉向某一模式，以及模型能否保持自身一贯的逻辑能力，从而为可靠、可控的LLM设计提供线索。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.27251v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) acquire reasoning capabilities through shared inference patterns in pre-training data, which are further elicited via Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, whether fundamental reasoning patterns, such as induction, deduction, and abduction, can be decoupled from specific problem instances remains a critical challenge for model controllability. In this paper, we present the first systematic investigation of this problem through the lens of reasoning conflicts, an explicit tension between parametric and contextual…
items.why_zh: 这项研究首次系统关注LLM基本推理模式是否受具体上下文牵制，为提升模型的可控性与可靠性提供了新视角。
items.why_en: It systematically investigates whether LLM reasoning patterns can be separated from specific instances, shedding light on controllability under conflicting contexts.

items.title_zh: EPC-3D-Diff：用于 CBCT 到 CT 合成的等变物理一致性条件三维潜在扩散模型
items.title_en: EPC-3D-Diff: Equivariant Physics Consistent Conditional 3D Latent Diffusion for CBCT to CT Synthesis
items.summary_zh: 锥形束 CT（CBCT）在放射治疗中常用于患者摆位，但其定量可靠性因散射、噪声与重建伪影而受损，亨斯菲尔德单位（HU）的准确性因此受限。针对该问题，研究者提出 EPC-3D-Diff，一种新颖的条件三维潜在扩散模型，用于实现 CBCT 到 CT 的体素级合成。该模型创新地引入基于采集物理的投影域等变损失，并利用“体素平面内旋转对应于角度位移”这一几何特性，而不是常见的图像域等变。该约束使生成过程更符合真实 CT 成像物理，有助于提升合成 CT 的质量与一致性，为放疗中的定量成像提供了研究新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.20470v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Cone-beam CT (CBCT) is routinely acquired during radiotherapy for patient setup, but its quantitative reliability is degraded by scatter, noise, and reconstruction artifacts, limiting Hounsfield Unit (HU) accuracy. We propose EPC-3D-Diff, a novel conditional 3D latent diffusion framework for volumetric CBCT to CT synthesis that introduces a projection domain equivariance loss derived from acquisition physics. Unlike common image domain equivariance, we exploit the fact that an in plane rotation of the volume corresponds to an angular sh…
items.why_zh: 将采集物理驱动的等变约束引入扩散模型，可提高 CBCT 合成 CT 的定量准确性，对精准放疗具有重要潜在价值。
items.why_en: It brings physics-consistent equivariance into diffusion-based synthesis, potentially improving the quantitative accuracy of CBCT-to-CT conversion in radiotherapy.

items.title_zh: 基于错误答案微调后的激活表征线性可分性：大语言模型合成不诚实研究
items.title_en: Linear Separability of Activation Representations after Supervised Fine-Tuning on Incorrect Responses: A Study of Synthetic Dishonesty in Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 该研究探讨了一个重要安全问题：当大语言模型被微调成系统性输出错误答案时，训练是否会在其内部激活中留下可被识别的结构化痕迹。作者在受控实验中使用五种不同架构、参数规模从 1.4B 到 9B 的 Transformer 模型，为每种模型分别用相同问题分布训练出“诚实”和“不诚实”两种 LoRA 变体，答案分别来自正确回答和看似合理但错误的回答。通过线性探针区分两类模型对同一问题的内部激活时，分类 AUC 接近上限，说明两种行为对应的表征高度线性可分。这表明人为引入的“合成不诚实”行为会在激活空间留下清晰的统计特征，可用于后续检测与审计。该研究为大模型安全对齐与滥用监控提供了新的分析工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.30381v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: When a language model is fine-tuned to produce systematically incorrect responses, does this training leave a structured, linearly recoverable trace in its internal activations? We study this question in a controlled model-organism setting using five transformer architectures spanning 1.4 to 9 billion parameters. For each model, an "honest" and a "dishonest" LoRA fine-tuned variant are constructed using identical question distributions but correct versus plausible-but-incorrect answers. Linear probes reach near-ceiling separability (AUC…
items.why_zh: 该研究揭示了大模型被诱导产生系统性错误后，其内部激活中仍存在可被线性解码的特征，为识别和检测模型的对齐风险提供了新方法。
items.why_en: It shows that intentionally induced dishonest behavior in LLMs leaves linearly separable traces in activations, offering a promising avenue for model auditing and safety monitoring.

items.title_zh: AI 辅助工作流管理中的复杂性与规模：一项联邦学习案例研究
items.title_en: Complexity and Scale in AI-Assisted Workflow Management: A Federated Learning Case Study
items.summary_zh: 医疗影像上的联邦学习工作流极其复杂：每个训练轮次都要向大量并行客户端任务分发计算，并在聚合步骤汇合结果以供下一轮使用。实际规模扩大后，整个系统可能包含 101 个子工作流和 2,679 个 GPU 任务，分布在四个站点，专家需要数月才能完成搭建，且大量精力耗在工作流本身的工程细节而非科学问题上。为了探索 AI 对这些流程的自动化能力，研究团队采用一个以 Pegasus 特定技能插件为基础的 LLM 智能体，让它可以首先生成一份可审查、包含可检查约束的规格说明书。这一思路将工作流构建从纯手工转向“人审规格 + 机器编流程”，有望显著降低重复劳动成本。这项工作揭示了大模型辅助复杂实验编排的潜力，也使研究者能够更专注于机器学习的核心科学问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.18425v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Federated learning over medical images is a demanding workflow application. Each round fans out across parallel client jobs and converges on an aggregation step that feeds the next round. At scale this yields 101 sub-workflows and 2,679 jobs on GPUs at four sites, which takes an expert months to build, mostly on workflow mechanics rather than science. We ask how far AI assistance can automate such workflows. An LLM agent, grounded in a released plugin of Pegasus-specific skills, first produces a reviewable specification of checkable con…
items.why_zh: 在分布式医学影像训练等大规模场景中，工作流搭建耗时巨大；用 LLM 完成规格到流程的自动生成，可切实减轻科学家负担、加速实验周期。
items.why_en: It demonstrates how LLM agents can automate complex federated-learning workflow construction, reducing the manual overhead of large-scale experiment orchestration.

items.title_zh: HB-PVI：用于复杂活动识别的层次贝叶斯个性化与信息价值框架
items.title_en: HB-PVI: A Hierarchical Bayesian Personalization and Value-of-Information Framework for Complex Activity Recognition
items.summary_zh: 个性化方法能提高活动识别性能，但不同用户从中获得的增益差异很大，而且每次要求用户提供额外校准标签都会产生采集成本。为了在性能与成本之间取得平衡，研究者提出 HB-PVI 框架，使用层次贝叶斯方法将参与者异质性、四种个性化机制的收益与风险以及新增标签的价值统一建模。实验使用 47 名参与者的 MUSIC-CAR 复杂活动数据集，并通过无泄漏的留一参与者方法进行验证（结合序列化评估）。该框架能够帮助系统在预算有限时判断“是否”以及“何时”获取额外标签，从而实现有针对性的个性化。这项工作为现实世界可穿戴活动识别系统的部署提供了兼顾效果与代价的决策工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Personalization can improve activity-recognition performance, but participant-specific gains are heterogeneous, and every additional calibration label has an acquisition cost. This study presents HB-PVI, a hierarchical Bayesian personalization and value-of-information framework jointly modeling participant heterogeneity, the benefit and harm of four personalization mechanisms, and the economic value of an additional label, for the 47-participant MUSIC-CAR complex-activity cohort. A leakage-safe, leave-one-participant-out evaluation combines a seq…
items.why_zh: 本框架为活动识别中的个性化引入了“信息价值”概念，让系统在有限标注预算下知道何时值得向用户获取额外数据，提升了部署的实用性与经济性。
items.why_en: It provides a principled way to balance personalization gains against annotation costs, guiding when it is worthwhile to query users for additional labels in activity recognition.

items.title_zh: GraphNOSE：嗅觉领域中的图 Transformer
items.title_en: GraphNOSE: A Graph Transformer in Olfaction
items.summary_zh: 从分子结构直接预测气味性质是化学信息学中的长期难题。传统线性模型虽然能建立分子特征与气味描述符之间的简单关联，但面对全新化学骨架、极端分子质量或复杂气味混合物时往往外推能力不足。为此，研究者提出 GraphNOSE，一个开源的图 Transformer 框架，能够从简化分子线性输入规范（SMILES）字符串预测单分子与二元混合物的多标签气味描述符。模型整合了位置编码等结构信息，从而更充分地利用分子图中的拓扑关系。GraphNOSE 为计算嗅觉研究提供了一种可扩展的现代建模工具，有助于在香料设计、化学品安全等领域加速分子筛选与气味预测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting olfactory qualities from molecular structure is an open problem in chemoinformatics. Although linear models can link molecular features to odor descriptors, they often fail when extrapolating to novel chemical scaffolds, extreme molecular weights, or complex odor mixtures. To address this, we introduce GraphNOSE, an open-source graph transformer framework that predicts multi-label odor descriptors from simplified molecular-input line-entry system (SMILES) strings for single molecules and binary mixtures. By integrating positional and s…
items.why_zh: GraphNOSE 提供了一种基于图结构、能处理复杂分子混合物的气味预测新方法，弥补了传统模型在新颖化学结构上的不足，有助推动计算嗅觉与分子设计。
items.why_en: It supplies an open-source graph transformer that better handles novel molecules and mixtures, advancing structure-to-odor prediction for computational chemistry.

items.title_zh: 面向有限反馈的大语言模型专家在线学习
items.title_en: Online Learning with LLM Experts from Limited Feedback
items.summary_zh: 当多个大语言模型作为可调用专家在线服务时，系统需要为每个用户提示选择最合适的模型，以最大化回答质量；但在实际中，每次调用只能观察到少量反馈。本文将这一选择过程形式化为带有上下文特征的老虎机问题：K 个动作对应 K 个 LLM 专家，d 维特征代表提示，T 轮为学习周期。研究者提出了策略性选择反馈与奖励观测的算法，以最小化累积悔失：在全信息场景下悔失约为 Õ(dT/√m)，在仅有 bandit 反馈场景下约为 Õ(dT√(K/m))，其中 m 远小于 T。这套在线学习框架为资源受限的模型路由提供了理论保证，使系统能在少量反馈下高效适应不同用户需求。该工作对于构建大规模、自适应的 LLM 服务具有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05820v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study adaptive routing of prompts to large language model (LLM) experts to maximize response quality in an online setting with limited feedback. We formulate it as a bandit problem with $K$ actions that represent experts and $d$ features that encode prompts, over a horizon of $T$ rounds. We propose algorithms that strategically select and observe rewards to minimize regret. In the full-information setting, we achieve a regret of $\tilde{O}(d T / \sqrt{m})$, while in the bandit setting we achieve $\tilde{O}(d T \sqrt{K / m})$, where $m \ll T$ i…
items.why_zh: 该研究为有限反馈下大模型专家路由提供了在线学习算法与遗憾保证，是资源受限环境中提升 LLM 服务质量和效率的关键技术基础。
items.why_en: It offers a rigorous online-learning framework for routing prompts among LLM experts with limited feedback, providing regret guarantees that support cost-effective model selection.

items.title_zh: 预算受限的任务感知动态网络获取
items.title_en: Budgeted Task-Aware Acquisition of Dynamic Networks
items.summary_zh: 动态网络上的机器学习通常受制于不完整观测：图结构随时间变化但并不能随时全部得到，而采集当前图信息既要付出观测开销，也要消耗计算资源，因此完整更新的代价在很多场景下不可接受。该论文提出“预算受限的任务感知获取”问题：模型在给定预算下，必须决定优先刷新哪些已过时的图信息，以最有利于某一特定下游任务。为此，作者推出了 Scout，一种轻量级框架，它通过已维护的图数据与观测历史，学习“查询某个节点”对当前任务所带来的价值，从而选择最有信息量的节点进行更新。该方法把有限的更新预算用在对任务影响最大的地方，显著提升资源利用效率。这项工作对通信网络、知识图谱等需要实时向量化更新的服务具有直接应用价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learning on dynamic graphs is difficult when changes in the underlying network are only partially observed. Acquiring current graph information incurs observation and computational costs, making complete updates impractical under limited resources. This paper focuses on budgeted task-aware acquisition on dynamic networks, where a model needs to decide which stale graph information to refresh for a downstream task. We propose Scout, a lightweight framework that learns the task value of querying each node from the maintained graph and observation h…
items.why_zh: 该研究为动态图学习中的更新决策提供了任务驱动的预算分配策略，使模型能在资源约束下优先获取最有价值的信息，提升实时图应用的效率。
items.why_en: It addresses the practical challenge of deciding which nodes to refresh in evolving networks under a fixed budget, steering acquisition toward information most valuable to the downstream task.

items.title_zh: Tsetlin 机中的压缩循环反馈：一项可复现的布尔有限状态机研究
items.title_en: Compressed Recurrent Feedback in Tsetlin Machines: A Reproducible Boolean-FSM Study
items.summary_zh: 在小型设备上进行序列推理时，模型需要保留有用的历史信息，同时又不能反复处理很长的输入记录。递归 Tsetlin 机（RTM）通过把上一时刻的布尔子句输出作为下一时刻的输入来提供这种记忆，但直接反馈的宽度会随子句库的规模线性增长，导致递归输入不必要地过宽。本文研究了一种固定宽度的替代方法：先用异或（XOR）折叠把众多子句激活压缩成较窄的比特表示，以两个时间尺度保留这些折叠后的比特，再用阈值化将其恢复成后续的反馈输入。这一设计使循环反馈的规模不再受子句数量的直接影响，在保持序列记忆能力的同时降低存储与计算开销。该工作在布尔有限状态机（Boolean-FSM）基准上进行了可复现实验，验证了方法的有效性，为在边缘设备上部署可解释的递归学习模型提供了更可行的技术路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.06133v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sequential inference on small devices requires a model to retain useful history without repeatedly processing a long input record. A Recurrent Tsetlin Machine (RTM) provides this memory by returning Boolean clause outputs from one time step as inputs to the next. Direct feedback, however, grows with the clause bank and can make the recurrent input unnecessarily wide. This paper investigates a fixed-width alternative. We combine clause activations by exclusive-OR (XOR) folding, retain the folded bits at two time scales, and threshold them back to…
items.why_zh: 压缩递归反馈使 Tsetlin 机在维持时序记忆能力的同时不再受子句数量约束，极大增强了其在边缘设备等低资源场景下的可用性。
items.why_en: It introduces a fixed-width compressed recurrence scheme for Tsetlin machines, enabling compact sequential inference on resource-constrained devices without losing the benefits of recurrent memory.

items.title_zh: MOLE：检测AI代理内部的威胁基准
items.title_en: MOLE: Detecting Insider Threats in AI Agents
items.summary_zh: 模型错位、提示注入或操作者滥用，可能让操控前沿实验室账户的AI代理窃取模型权重、投毒训练数据或削弱发布防线。但现有基准并未检验防御者能否在有限的审查预算下、从日常工作中识别出此类威胁。为此，研究者推出MOLE，一个包含150个AI运营账户、共享9种有状态服务、跨越30个工作日、涵盖12种威胁与来自四个模型共约200亿token语料库的开放基准。初步结果显示，39个代理模型中有72%能完成大部分被分配的任务，说明威胁行为并不难实施。MOLE为AI安全和内部威胁检测提供了统一测评平台。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.06966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Model misalignment, prompt injection, or operator misuse could lead AI agents operating frontier-lab accounts to exfiltrate model weights, poison training data, or weaken release gates. Existing benchmarks do not test whether defenders can detect this activity among routine work under a limited review budget. We introduce MOLE, an open benchmark of 150 AI-operated accounts sharing 9 stateful services over 30 workdays, with 12 threats and 8 corpora from four models totaling roughly 20 billion tokens. Of 39 agent models, 72% complete most assigned…
items.why_zh: 这是首个为“有限审查预算下的AI代理恶意行为检测”而设计的公开基准，对前沿模型安全防线建设意义重大。
items.why_en: It is the first open benchmark for detecting insider threats by AI agents within a limited review budget, vital for securing frontier models.

items.title_zh: 共享注意力向量为何失效：结果索引调优
items.title_en: Why shared attention vectors fail: a case for outcome-indexed tuning
items.summary_zh: 在学习模型中，维度注意力常被实现为全局共享的注意力向量——每个刺激维度对应一个标量，并通过梯度下降自动调节其显著性。这项研究发现，当模型需要同时预测多个结果时，这种共享向量会变得不稳定，快速坍缩到上下界，从而阻碍模型形成有意义的注意力分布，损害学习与泛化。为克服该问题，作者提出按结果分别索引的注意力调优方式，使每个输出结果能够维持独立的注意力调谐。该工作为多输出学习的表征设计提供了重要指导。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.08615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dimensional attention in learning is often implemented as a globally shared attention vector, where each stimulus dimension corresponds to a single scalar. These scalars are learned by models through gradient-descent on error, where predictive features acquire more salience. We show that under multi-outcome learning, where models predict more than one outcome, this shared vector becomes unstable; it collapses to its bounds and prevents the models from learning meaningful attentional tunings for learning and generalization. We address this by intr…
items.why_zh: 揭示多任务学习中共用注意力向量的隐蔽缺陷，提出的结果索引调优方案对设计稳定的多输出模型具有实用价值。
items.why_en: It uncovers why shared attention breaks in multi-outcome models and offers an outcome-indexed remedy that can stabilize learning.

items.title_zh: 高斯线性函数流形法：面向海量点云数据的地形建模
items.title_en: Gaussian Linear Functional Manifold Method for Massive Point Cloud Data
items.summary_zh: 在复杂的野地-城市界面环境中，从大规模非结构化机载LiDAR点云重建连续地形仍面临挑战：深度神经网络需要昂贵的逐点标注，而非参数化表面重建方法往往缺乏结构可解释性。该研究提出高斯线性函数流形（GLFM），一种物理信息统计框架：利用确定性线性函数基表示连续地表形态，同时对微观结构进行建模。该方法有望弥补深度学习方法与经典表面重建之间的空白，为大规模点云数据提供更可解释、更具物理一致性的地形建模手段。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05744v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reconstructing continuous terrain manifolds from massive, unstructured airborne LiDAR point clouds remains challenging in complex Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) environments, where deep neural networks require costly point-wise annotations and nonparametric surface reconstruction methods often lack structural interpretability. This paper introduces the Gaussian Linear Functional Manifold (GLFM), a physics-informed statistical framework that represents continuous surface topography using deterministic linear functional bases while modeling micro…
items.why_zh: 为海量LiDAR点云地形重建提供了一种可解释且物理一致的统计建模新路径，补充了深度学习与非参数法的不足。
items.why_en: It provides an interpretable, physics-informed statistical alternative for terrain reconstruction from massive point clouds, complementing deep and nonparametric methods.

items.title_zh: AAMBERS-UAV：顾及采集过程的无人机杂草稻分割多模态骨干评估与排名
items.title_en: AAMBERS-UAV: Acquisition-Aware Multimodal Backbone Evaluation and Ranking for UAV Weedy Rice Segmentation
items.summary_zh: 无人机影像序列中的帧在空间和时间上彼此关联，但常规语义分割基准常按图像级随机划分数据。这种划分会使同一次飞行采集的样本既进入训练集又进入测试集，从而高估模型应用于新调查时的泛化能力。本文基于包含734个样本的WeedyRice-RGBMS-DB数据集，固定124张图像作为目标采集测试集，并在训练、验证、测试数量完全一致的前提下，比较了两种方案：target-held-out（开发时完全排除目标采集）和target-exposed（允许目标采集进入开发）。由此对多种多模态骨干网络进行更公平的评估与排名，为UAV影像分割提供了更贴近真实应用的评测协议。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05762v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: UAV image collections contain spatially and temporally related frames, yet semantic-segmentation benchmarks commonly split them at image level. Such splitting can place samples from one acquisition in both model development and testing, obscuring transfer to a genuinely new survey. Using the 734-sample WeedyRice-RGBMS-DB, we fix a 124-image target-acquisition test set and compare two protocols with identical train, validation, and test counts: target-held-out, which excludes the target acquisition from development, and target-exposed, which adm…
items.why_zh: 指出了无人机语义分割中因图像级划分导致的时序数据泄漏问题，为评测模型真实跨调查泛化能力提供了更严谨的标准。
items.why_en: It highlights temporal leakage in split-based UAV benchmarks and proposes acquisition-aware protocols to measure real-world generalization of segmentation models.

items.title_zh: FALCON-S：固定翼近地气动仿真与飞行控制学习套件
items.title_en: FALCON-S: Fixed-wing ground-effect Aerodynamics Simulator and Flight Control Learning Suite
items.summary_zh: FALCON-S是一个模块化的高保真仿真框架，用于开发和测试固定翼无人机的近地飞行控制策略。与依赖简化动力学或悬停模型的常见仿真器不同，它完整建模了六自由度刚体动力学、半经验地面效应空气动力学、执行器动力学、传感器噪声以及环境扰动。这种物理真实性与模块化组件设计相结合，使研究者能够系统分析真实条件下的低空飞行行为，也便于开展控制算法的训练与对比评估。作为一套面向飞行控制学习的工具，FALCON-S为近地飞行控制研究提供了可靠的测试基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.06046v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a modular, high-fidelity simulation framework for the development and benchmarking of flight control strategies in fixed-wing aerial robots operating near the ground. Unlike existing simulators that rely on simplified or hover-oriented dynamics, our framework models full 6DoF rigid-body physics, semi-empirical ground-effect aerodynamics, actuator dynamics, sensor noise, and environmental disturbances. This physical realism, combined with modular component design, enables systematic analysis of low-altitude flight behavior under reali…
items.why_zh: 针对固定翼近地飞行缺乏高保真仿真环境的问题，FALCON-S为研究地面效应下的飞行控制提供了完整、可复现的测试平台。
items.why_en: FALCON-S fills the gap in high-fidelity simulation for fixed-wing ground-effect flight, enabling systematic development and benchmarking of control strategies.

items.title_zh: 面向分类风险的可选标签获取
items.title_en: Large Classification-Risk-Optional Label Acquisition
items.summary_zh: 在特征可观测而标签需要额外成本获取的场景中，如何分配有限的标注预算才能最有效地降低分类错误是一重要问题。该研究针对多类零一风险，在参数化分类模型下考察最优标签获取策略。作者将已获取标签提供的Fisher信息与多分类超额风险的局部几何相结合，推导出一个标签采集准则，其作用是使期望多类超额风险的主要渐近项最小化。这一准则为预算受限时的主动学习样本选择提供了理论依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.06873v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study how a limited labeling budget should be allocated to minimize multiclass zero-one classification risk. We consider parametric classification problems in which features are observed for all sampling units while class labels can be acquired selectively. By combining the Fisher information supplied by an acquired label with the local geometry of multiclass excess risk, we derive an acquisition criterion that minimizes the leading asymptotic coefficient of expected multiclass excess risk. The resulting rule values a label according to how…
items.why_zh: 为主动学习中的标签预算分配提供了一种基于分类风险渐近理论的最优策略，有助于在有限标注资源下训练更优分类器。
items.why_en: It supplies a risk-theoretic optimal rule for choosing labels under budget limits, advancing practical active learning and classification.

items.title_zh: Marigold V2：重新审视扩散Transformer用于单目深度估计
items.title_en: Marigold V2: Revisiting Diffusion Transformers for Monocular Depth Estimation
items.summary_zh: 单目深度估计是计算机视觉中常见但高度不适定（ill-posed）的任务，在场景重建、计算摄影与机器人等领域有广泛应用。尽管该领域较为成熟，现有模型仍难以在分布外输入上稳定泛化，并且难以输出清晰、精细的深度图。Marigold V2重新审视了基于扩散Transformer（DiT）架构的一类技术——将现代图像生成与编辑模型改造为单目深度估计器。该工作旨在利用扩散先验进一步提升单目深度预测的泛化能力和边缘细节质量，为高精度深度估计提供新的扩散生成思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.08084v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Monocular depth estimation is a ubiquitous yet highly ill-posed computer vision task, with downstream applications in scene reconstruction, computational photography, and robotics, among others. Despite the field's maturity, recent models still struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution inputs and to produce sharp and detailed depth maps. In this paper, we revisit Marigold, a set of techniques for repurposing modern image generation and editing models, powered by the diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture, into state-of-the-art monocular d…
items.why_zh: 单目深度估计关系众多视觉应用，利用扩散Transformer来增强深度预测的泛化性与细节保真度，有望推动相关技术实用化。
items.why_en: It advances diffusion-transformers for monocular depth, addressing generalization and detail challenges that matter for real-world vision applications.

items.title_zh: 随机学习动力学中的信息获取速度极限
items.title_en: Speed Limit for Information Acquisition in Stochastic Learning Dynamics
items.summary_zh: 神经网络通过学习获取内部表征，但学习过程能多快地从数据中提取信息始终缺少统一的刻画。该研究将随机梯度下降（SGD）视为马尔可夫随机过程，并推导出一个基于Fisher信息的信息流速度极限，用以约束可训练参数在单位时间内能从数据生成过程潜在变量中获取的信息量。推导出的不等式将信息流分解为漂移项与噪声项，从而可分别度量确定性学习力和SGD诱导涨落的作用。这一视角从信息论上解释了学习动态中“信号”与“噪声”的协同，为理解深度学习的收敛机理提供了新框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.08219v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural networks acquire internal representations through learning. In this work, we formulate stochastic gradient descent (SGD) as a Markovian stochastic process and derive a Fisher-information flow speed limit that bounds the rate at which trainable parameters can acquire information about latent variables in the data-generating process. The resulting inequality decomposes the information flow into drift and noise contributions, thereby quantifying the roles of deterministic learning forces and SGD-induced fluctuations from an information-theo…
items.why_zh: 首次为随机学习过程中的信息获取速率给出理论极限，有助于从信息论角度理解和改进神经网络的优化动力学。
items.why_en: It provides a theoretical bound on how fast stochastic learning can acquire information, offering a new lens on deep learning dynamics and optimization.

items.title_zh: 带背包约束的高维线性老虎机
items.title_en: High-dimensional Linear Bandits with Knapsacks
items.summary_zh: 该文研究高维线性设置下的带背包约束的上下文老虎机（CBwK）问题，其中候选特征维度可能非常高。作者的目标是利用参数稀疏性来获得更紧凑的遗憾界。为此，他们先提出一种在线硬阈值算法，在数据依次到达时进行稀疏参数估计；随后把这个在线估计器嵌入原-对偶框架，为每个背包（资源）约束引入一个对偶变量，并利用在线学习规则更新这些变量，以控制整个过程中累积资源不越界。这种设计在高维、资源受限的序列决策场景中兼顾了统计效率与约束满足。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2311.01327v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the contextual bandits with knapsack (CBwK) problem in a high-dimensional linear setting, where the feature dimension can be very large. Our goal is to harness sparsity to obtain sharper regret guarantees. To this end, we first develop an online variant of the hard thresholding algorithm that performs the sparse estimation in an online manner. We then embed this estimator in a primal-dual scheme: every knapsack constraint is paired with a dual variable, which is updated by an online learning rule to keep the cumulative resource…
items.why_zh: 在高维资源受限的在线决策中，如何结合稀疏估计与背包约束仍具挑战，该方案给出了一条可行路径。
items.why_en: It provides a viable approach to combining sparse estimation with knapsack constraints in high-dimensional online decision-making.

items.title_zh: 相关性引导的域感知混合量子学习用于犯罪模式分析
items.title_en: Domain-Aware Hybrid Quantum Learning via Correlation-Guided Circuit Design for Crime Pattern Analytics
items.summary_zh: 该研究构建了一个用于犯罪模式分析的量子-经典比较框架，系统评估纯量子模型、经典机器学习基线以及两种混合量子-经典架构。面对快速城市化引发的高维、不平衡犯罪数据，作者在框架中引入域感知设计，并利用相关性引导的方法设计量子电路，以更好地匹配犯罪统计特征。基于16年的犯罪统计数据，论文对这些范式在分类任务上的表现进行了横向比较，试图识别何种计算范式更适合预测警务中的现实数据。这项工作为量子机器学习在执法数据分析中的可行性提供了实证参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.07389v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Crime pattern analysis is critical for law enforcement and predictive policing, yet the surge in criminal activities from rapid urbanization creates high-dimensional, imbalanced datasets that challenge traditional classification methods. This study presents a quantum-classical comparison framework for crime analytics, evaluating four computational paradigms: quantum models, classical baseline machine learning models, and two hybrid quantum-classical architectures. Using 16-year crime statistics, we systematically assess classification perform…
items.why_zh: 为评估量子/混合模型在真实高维不平衡犯罪数据上的表现提供了对照实验框架，是量子机器学习应用于公共安全的一次尝试。
items.why_en: It provides an experimental benchmark for quantum and hybrid models on real-world crime data, testing their potential in law enforcement analytics.

items.title_zh: 自适应模态获取的条件有效性：当策略选择自己的校准组
items.title_en: Conditional Validity for Adaptive Modality Acquisition: When the Policy Chooses Its Own Calibration Group
items.summary_zh: 多模态系统可能只使用部分输入模态就开始推理，并在需要时按一定成本获取其余模态。如果这一获取过程由策略自适应决定，那么最终哪些模态被观察到并非预先固定，常规的分组条件校准假设会被破坏。本文针对这种策略诱导的分组，重新讨论模式条件风险控制的有效性。作者刻画了在自适应获取情形下条件风险控制仍然成立的充分条件，并提出两种有限样本构造方法。该结果对需要动态决定是否补采数据以平衡成本与风险的推理系统尤其重要。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15520v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A multimodal system may begin inference while holding only some of its inputs and may acquire the rest at a cost. With adaptive acquisition, the policy determines which inputs are ultimately observed, so we state risk control conditional on that terminal input pattern. Conditional calibration typically assumes that the grouping map is fixed independently of the calibration sample, a condition that policy-induced grouping does not satisfy. We characterize when pattern-conditional risk control remains valid and give two finite-sample constructi…
items.why_zh: 它澄清了当策略自行决定获取流程时，我们还能否对最终输出做有效的风险控制，为有成本的自适应推理提供了理论基础。
items.why_en: It clarifies when we can still provide valid risk guarantees after an adaptive acquisition policy, supporting cost-aware multimodal inference.

items.title_zh: 推进开放可复现的关系学习：RelArena-α、TabPFN-Rel与RPI
items.title_en: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$\alpha$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
items.summary_zh: Prior Labs在关系学习方向发布了其首批开源成果，包括RelArena-α、TabPFN-Rel和RPI三套软件，旨在推动相关研究走向开放、可复现，并向实际应用转化。公告显示，这次α版本仍处于早期开发阶段，主要面向科研人员和早期实践者。开发团队表示，后续会依据社区反馈并以协作方式调整开发方向。近年来关系学习领域已积累了大量数据集与任务，而这套工具试图为研究者提供统一的软件基础，以降低验证与比较的难度。该发布体现了Prior Labs对开放科学的长期承诺，也为社区进一步协作奠定了基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16319v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $\alpha$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the c…
items.why_zh: 这是Prior Labs将开放科学理念带入关系学习领域的一次实质性动作，有望解决该领域工具碎片化、难复现的问题。
items.why_en: It signals Prior Labs' commitment to open, reproducible relational learning, providing shared infrastructure that may ease comparison and collaboration.

items.title_zh: 参数化知识图谱记忆中的存储-检索差距
items.title_en: A Storage-Retrieval Gap in Parametric Knowledge Graph Memory
items.summary_zh: 基于图检索增强生成（Graph RAG）的系统在查询时要把检索出的子图放入模型上下文，既带来持续的token成本，也可能每次访问都暴露源数据。本文考虑一种替代方案：先将知识图谱离线编译为按实体存储的LoRA适配器库，作为参数化知识层；查询通过注入适配器权重而非文本来进行，从而在查询时不消耗额外上下文。在MetaQA数据集上，这些由子图训练得到的适配器能够编码独立于上下文的事实知识，并泛化到未见过的问题。该结果展示了用参数化记忆直接承载知识图谱的可行性，并揭示了此类存储方式与检索行为之间存在值得关注的差距。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.25489v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph retrieval-augmented generation places retrieved subgraphs into the model's context window at query time, paying a recurring token cost and exposing source data on every call. We study an alternative: compiling a knowledge graph offline into a bank of LoRA adapters, one per entity, that serve as a parametric knowledge layer queried by injecting weights rather than text, at zero query-time context cost. On the MetaQA dataset, we find that subgraph-trained adapters encode context-free factual knowledge that generalizes to unseen questions:…
items.why_zh: 它演示了知识图谱可以不靠大上下文而是以轻量参数化记忆的形式注入模型，可能降低推理成本并减少源数据暴露。
items.why_en: It demonstrates that knowledge graphs can be stored as lightweight parameter memory instead of retrieval context, potentially cutting inference cost and protecting source data.

items.title_zh: Tempora-Fusion：具有高效可验证同态线性组合的时间锁谜题
items.title_en: Tempora-Fusion: Time-Lock Puzzle with Efficient Verifiable Homomorphic Linear Combination
items.summary_zh: Tempora-Fusion被提出为第一个具有高效公开验证能力的同态时间锁谜题（TLP）方案：不仅单个谜题的解可验证，对多个谜题的线性组合结果也能公开验证。该方案允许客户端各自独立生成谜题，之后再授权一个带独立解锁时间的线性组合，任何一方都可在不依赖可信初始化或复杂非对称证明系统的情况下确认释放出的结果有效。构造上，作者把一个个独立生成的RSA类型谜题映射到某个公共有限域，并使用不经意线性评估等原语实现组合操作。该方法为需要时间门控与多方协作的可验证加密计算提供了新的选择。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2406.15070v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present Tempora-Fusion, the first homomorphic TLP scheme with efficient public verification of both individual puzzle solutions and homomorphic linear combinations. Tempora-Fusion lets clients generate puzzles independently, later authorize a linear combination with its own release time, and enables any party to verify the released result without trusted setup or costly asymmetric-key proof systems. Technically, our construction maps independently generated RSA-based puzzles into a common finite field, uses oblivious linear evaluatio…
items.why_zh: 首个实现了同态线性组合高效公开验证的时间锁谜题方案，降低了可信设置要求，可支撑分布式时间门控计算。
items.why_en: It is the first TLP supporting efficiently verifiable homomorphic linear combinations without trusted setup, enabling new forms of time-controlled distributed computation.

items.title_zh: 面向高斯过程模型的鲁棒自适应模型预测控制方法
items.title_en: A robust and adaptive MPC formulation for Gaussian process models
items.summary_zh: 该文面向由有界扰动和未建模非线性影响的不确定系统，提出一种鲁棒自适应模型预测控制（MPC）框架。作者利用高斯过程（GP）根据带噪声的测量数据在线学习系统的未知动态，测量数据可以来自系统运行过程。核心贡献在于：借助收缩度量为GP模型推导出鲁棒预测，并把这些预测纳入MPC优化中。理论分析表明，该控制器能保证递归可行性并满足鲁棒约束。该方法将数据驱动学习与传统MPC理论结合，提升了控制器在处理模型失配和未知动态时的可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.02098v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper, we present a robust and adaptive model predictive control (MPC) framework for uncertain nonlinear systems affected by bounded disturbances and unmodeled nonlinearities. We use Gaussian Processes (GPs) to learn the uncertain dynamics based on noisy measurements, including those collected during system operation. As a key contribution, we derive robust predictions for GP models using contraction metrics, which are incorporated in the MPC formulation. The proposed design guarantees recursive feasibility, robust constraint sa…
items.why_zh: 它让MPC能边运行边学习未知动态，同时保留经典鲁棒性理论保证，是学习与控制融合的一个有价值方案。
items.why_en: It unifies online Gaussian-process learning with robust MPC guarantees, allowing controllers to adapt to unknown dynamics without sacrificing safety.

items.title_zh: 分子通信中游程受限信道编码的掩码神经检测
items.title_en: Masked Neural Detection for Run-Length-Limited Channel Coding in Molecular Communication
items.summary_zh: 分子通信（Molecular Communication）中，分子在信道中的扩散会造成存储效应：为当前符号释放的分子，可能拖延到后面若干符号时隙才被接收，形成强码间干扰。此前研究发现滑动双向递归神经网络（SBRNN）等神经检测器在分子信道中能够大幅超过传统阈值检测。本文针对这一背景提出一个问题：若一种游程受限（RLL）编码原来在阈值检测下被证明性能更优，那么当编码传输与未编码传输都用更强大的神经检测器评估时，原来的优势是否仍然成立？作者采用掩码式神经检测对这种编码场景进行检验并给出相应判断。该结果提醒检测算法的进步可能改变编码设计的评判标准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.12489v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Molecular communication (MC) suffers from severe diffusion memory because molecules released for one symbol may arrive during later symbol intervals. Neural sequence detectors, especially sliding bidirectional recurrent neural networks (SBRNNs), substantially outperform threshold detection in such channels. This raises a central question for MC channel coding: does a code whose superiority was established under threshold detection retain it when both coded and uncoded transmission are evaluated with neural detection? This letter answers…
items.why_zh: 揭示了检测器选择会显著影响编码方案性能评判，对分子通信编码与检测的联合设计具有启发。
items.why_en: It calls into question code evaluations based on legacy detectors, motivating joint design of coding and neural detection in molecular communication.

items.title_zh: PRISM：面向自主交通系统主动安全的智能体多模型架构
items.title_en: PRISM: An Agentic Multi-Model Architecture for Proactive Safety in Autonomous Transportation Systems
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究提出名为PRISM（主动风险情报与安全管理）的智能体多模型架构，旨在为自主与智能交通系统提供主动安全保障。研究指出，现有高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）多为反应式机制，只在危险出现后才触发，难以应对车辆、行人与骑行者等在复杂城市环境中的动态交互；美国弱势道路使用者死亡人数持续上升，凸显了这一缺陷。PRISM将车辆行为、环境条件及弱势道路使用者状态纳入统一的风险管理框架，希望在风险形成之前进行识别和干预。该研究为自动驾驶安全从“事后响应”转向“提前预防”提供了一种新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.01623v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Autonomous and intelligent transportation systems operate in complex urban environments where safety depends on interactions among vehicle behavior, environmental conditions, and vulnerable road users (VRUs) such as pedestrians and cyclists. Most advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) employ reactive mechanisms that activate only after hazards have emerged, a critical limitation underscored by rising VRU fatalities in the United States. This study introduces PRISM (Proactive Risk Intelligence and Safety Management), an agentic multi-…
items.why_zh: 它针对当前辅助驾驶系统只能“事后介入”的核心短板，提出从被动安全转向主动风险管理的架构方向。
items.why_en: It addresses the core limitation of reactive ADAS by proposing an agentic, proactive safety approach for autonomous vehicles and vulnerable road users.

items.title_zh: OpenAI AI 训练版权纠纷案新细节：GPT-5 可代笔乔治 ·R·R· 马丁撰写《冰与火之歌》
items.title_en: New Details in OpenAI Copyright Dispute: GPT-5 Could Ghostwrite George R.R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 9 日消息，科技媒体 torrentfreak 昨日（9 月 8 日）发布博文，报道称多名图书作者本周向纽约联邦法院提交简易判决动议，要求法官认定 OpenAI 未经许可复制作品，且相关行为不构成合理使用。 这起诉讼可以追溯到美国作家协会于 2023 年对 OpenAI 和微软提起的集体诉讼，该协会主张认为在未经许可的情况下，OpenAI 擅自利用涉案作者的作品来训练 AI。 根据披露的相关文件，动议涉及 194 部图书，当前寻求认定责任，并未要求裁定赔偿金额。作者指控 OpenAI 曾从 LibGen 获取图书，并在 GPT-3 论文中将“Libgen1”“Libgen 2”改称“Books1”“Books2”。原告认为，这一命名变化意在淡化训练数据与 LibGen 的关联。 《冰与火之歌》作者乔治 ·R·R· 马丁（George R. R. Martin）是本案原告之一，该系列后来被 HBO 改编为电视剧《权力的游戏》。 原告在动议中援引 OpenAI 员工 Tarun Gogineni 的公开帖文作为证据。OpenAI 于 2022 年聘请 Gogineni 负责提升模型的写作质量；原告认为，他知道相关模型可能冲击作者职业，并将这种影响称为“可接受的经济扰动”。 Gogineni 在 2025 年、即马丁起诉近 2 年后发帖称，其“研究任务”是让 GPT 模…
items.summary_en: George R.R. Martin and other authors are seeking summary judgment against OpenAI, arguing its use of their books for AI training was not fair use. The motion covers 194 books and highlights OpenAI's alleged reliance on LibGen and the renaming of datasets, plus employee comments about 'acceptable economic disruption'. Court filings also suggest GPT-5 could ghostwrite Martin's works, underscoring the commercial threat to authors.
items.why_zh: 本案将决定AI训练中使用未授权书籍是否落入合理使用范畴，直接影响大模型版权规则的走向。
items.why_en: This case tests whether copyrighted books can be freely used to train AI models, setting the rules for future content creation and AI development.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 9 日消息，曹操出行今日宣布与豆包联合打造 AI 打车服务 ，首批在北京、杭州、苏州三城上线，这意味着曹操出行将出行服务能力与 AI Agent 深度融合。 AI 打车服务上线后，当用户在豆包产品端咨询路线、地点、休闲娱乐、美食店铺等本地生活信息时，系统不仅能够提供资讯内容， 还可结合地点，主动生成合适的出行方案供用户选择 ，让信息获取、行程规划和出行履约形成连贯体验。 此外，基于曹操出行的场景服务体系，豆包 AI 打车可实现更精准的服务适配。用户提出大空间、提前通风等不同需求时， 系统可智能匹配专车、智能大白车等选项 。 曹操出行还在苏、杭部分地区 试行无障碍服务 ，当用户在聊天中提及轮椅、行动不便等情况，系统可智能识别并推荐无障碍专车。 IT之家从合作公告获悉，依托曹操出行定制车智能车控能力， 用户可以直接在豆包对话界面中预先设定行车路线、空调温度、通风模式、音乐风格等个性化偏好 。 IT 之家小伙伴记得用 最会买打车 ，享受折扣价的同时还可以获得返利，单单都能省钱！
items.summary_en: Cao Cao Mobility and Doubao have launched an AI ride-hailing service in Beijing, Hangzhou and Suzhou, integrating ride-hailing with an AI agent that proactively suggests travel plans based on local-life queries. The system can match users with appropriate vehicle types by understanding requests like 'larger space' or 'ventilate in advance', and pilots accessible-vehicle services in parts of Hangzhou and Suzhou. Custom vehicles also support conversational presets for routes, AC, ventilation, and music.
items.why_zh: 它把AI对话、场景理解与车内控制打通，使打车服务从单一订单变成完整的智能出行助理，是AI Agent应用的标杆案例。
items.why_en: By linking conversation, scene understanding, and in-car controls, this service turns ride-hailing into a full intelligent assistant experience and sets a benchmark for AI-agent applications.

items.summary_en: Renault reported H1 2026 revenue of €30.252 billion, up 9.5% YoY, with attributable net profit of €705 million, reversing a year-ago loss. Free cash flow also turned positive at €653 million. The results were seen as beating expectations and aligning with the company's full-year guidance.

items.summary_en: Audi posted H1 2026 revenue of €29.177 billion, down 10.4% YoY, and attributable net profit of €1.123 billion, a 16.6% decline. Deliveries slipped 7.2% to 736,878 vehicles, while operating cash flow rose 20.5% to €3.644 billion. The results were in line with expectations despite global and tariff headwinds.
items.why_zh: 奥迪利润下滑凸显传统豪华车市场面临的宏观与关税压力，其经营现金流增长又为后续投资留出空间。
items.why_en: Audi's weakening earnings highlight headwinds for luxury automakers, though stronger cash flow offers flexibility for future investment.

items.title_en: Musk's Ex-Girlfriend Says He Wanted 'Big Brood' Before Civil War, Reveals $40M NDA Offer
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 9 日消息，埃隆 · 马斯克前女友、美国保守派评论人士阿什莉 · 圣克莱尔（Ashley St Clair）透露，马斯克曾发短信告诉她，希望在“内战爆发前拥有一大批孩子”。 上述内容出自亚历克斯 · 吉布尼（Alex Gibney）执导的新纪录片《Musk》中，圣克莱尔在威尼斯电影节首映礼上也谈及了马斯克及其社交平台 X 的影响。 圣克莱尔与马斯克于 2024 年育有一名儿子，此后两人即分手。她还表示，马斯克的团队曾提出用 4,000 万美元 （现汇率约合 2.69 亿元人民币） 一次性款项以及每月 10 万美元 （现汇率约合 67.3 万元人民币） 的补助来换她签署保密协议，但在她拒绝签署后，对方撤回了这一提议。 在纪录片《Musk》的威尼斯电影节首映礼上，圣克莱尔被问及马斯克究竟是担心发生内战，还是在主动推动内战。她表示，无论是哪种情况，马斯克通过 X 所进行的活动都不能被忽视，并称相关内容正在现实世界产生影响。 圣克莱尔曾支持美国总统特朗普，但她表示如今对自己过去参与的政治活动感到后悔。她认为，马斯克正在通过 X 制造“有意的分裂”，如果不加以监管或控制，可能造成严重后果。她指出，自 2022 年收购原名为 Twitter 的社交平台后，马斯克频繁利用 X 发布和传播个人政治观点。 导演吉布尼在威尼斯接受采访时表示，马斯克对文明崩溃的关注可能与其在南非的童年…
items.summary_en: Ashley St Clair, Elon Musk's ex-girlfriend, claims in the documentary 'Musk' that he texted about wanting a large brood of children before a 'civil war.' She says she rejected a $40 million NDA offer (plus $100,000 per month) after their 2024 child. She also accuses Musk of using X to foster deliberate division.
items.why_zh: 该爆料将马斯克个人世界观、人口言论与X平台的社会影响联系到一起，再度引发公众关注。
items.why_en: The revelation links Musk's personal worldview and his platform's influence, fueling public scrutiny.

items.summary_en: According to IT Home, leaker Aaron Perris spotted 37 new hardware identifiers in Apple's backend, including seven iPhone identifiers (iPhone19,1–19,7). With rumored upcoming iPhones totaling six models, the extra identifier hints at an unknown variant or regional version ahead of Apple's September 10 event.
items.why_zh: 第七个iPhone标识符暗示苹果新品阵容可能比传闻更丰富，直接影响发布会预期。
items.why_en: A seventh iPhone identifier suggests Apple's upcoming lineup may be broader than rumored, shaping expectations for the event.

items.title_en: Sonos 27 Update Adds External AI Integration and Enhanced Surround Pairing
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 9 日消息，Sonos 昨日（9 月 8 日）发布新闻稿，宣布通过苹果 App Store 应用商店渠道，更新 Sonos 27 音频系统，并向 Sonos S2 系列产品免费推送。 产品命名方面，伴随着 Sonos Beam Ultra 回音壁、Sonos Ace Ultra 头戴式耳机两款新品， Sonos 于 9 月 1 日发布全新音频操作系统 Sonos 27 。 本次更新最大的亮点，在于通过抢先体验方式， 推出 Sonos 27mcp 来支持接入外部 AI。 IT之家援引博文介绍，该功能基于 Model Context Protocol（模型上下文协议），让 Sonos 系统接入 ChatGPT 和 Claude 等外部 AI 模型。 用户无需切换至 Sonos App，可在对应 AI 平台内调整播放和声音控制。Sonos 将该服务托管在 mcp.ws.sonos.com/ mcp。公司称，该开放平台允许用户按自身需求选择 AI 助手。 Sonos 还计划在 2026 年秋季晚些时候推出 Sonos 27voice 抢先体验版。该助手由 Sonos 内部开发和微调，可理解歌曲线索、情绪描述及设备控制请求。用户即使忘记歌名或歌手，也可通过相关描述寻找音乐。 Sonos 还预告目标 2027 年推出 Sonos Custom Agents，让用户在系统中创建…
items.summary_en: Sonos began rolling out Sonos 27 to S2 products, introducing an early-access MCP-based feature (27mcp) that lets external AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude control playback. It also improves surround pairing, with a voice assistant preview and custom agents planned for later.
items.why_zh: Sonos 率先将外部大模型接入音频系统，预示智能音箱从封闭助手走向开放AI控制。
items.why_en: Sonos is opening its audio platform to external AI models, signaling a shift from closed assistants toward open AI control.

items.title_en: Meta Launches Personal AI Agent Muse, but Internal Tests Raise Privacy Concerns
items.summary_zh: 北京时间 9 月 9 日，据路透社报道，Meta 周二正式发布了其长期宣传的 AI 助手，该助手可自主代表用户完成发送邮件、卖车及预订旅行等任务。不过，Meta 内部担忧这项技术在处理敏感个人数据的访问权限时存在管理不善的问题。 这款 AI 智能体名为 Muse，在 Meta 内部称 Hatch，是该公司 CEO 马克 · 扎克伯格 (Mark Zuckerberg) 计划的核心产品。他想要向每天使用 Meta 服务的数十亿用户提供“个人超级智能”。 该计划是 Meta 为实现收入多元化、减少对广告依赖的最新尝试，同时也希望利用其在 AI 芯片及其他基础设施上的巨额投资打造一项可持续业务。Meta 预计今年在此方面的投入将超过 1300 亿美元。 Meta 在公告中表示，Muse 初期仅在美国上线，用户可通过专门的 Muse 应用或 Meta 旗下 WhatsApp 通讯服务使用。Meta 称“很快”会将这一智能体添加到其智能眼镜产品线中，但未透露具体细节。 Meta 发言人表示，该智能体将提供免费基础版本，同时推出每月 20 美元和每月 100 美元的订阅套餐，以满足更高频使用需求。Meta 表示，用户可以选择退出，不让自己的交互数据用于训练 Meta 的 AI 模型，公司计划在今年晚些时候推出 Muse 的加密版本。 安全问题 Meta 表示，Muse 以开源 AI 智能体 O…
items.summary_en: Meta has unveiled Muse, an AI agent that can autonomously send emails, sell cars, and book trips, with a free tier and $20/$100 monthly plans. It will roll out in the US via a dedicated app and WhatsApp. Despite the ambition, internal tests reportedly raised concerns about managing access to sensitive personal data.
items.why_zh: Muse 是 Meta 从广告模式转向个人 AI 服务的关键布局，但隐私管理疑虑可能影响用户信任。
items.why_en: Muse represents Meta's strategic bet on personal AI beyond ads, yet privacy concerns could undermine adoption.

items.title_zh: 继 Claude 尝试攻克黎曼猜想后：OpenAI 宣布用 10000 个 AI 智能体 88 小时攻克千禧年大奖难题，陶哲轩既点赞又担忧
items.title_en: OpenAI Says 10,000 AI Agents Solved a Millennium Problem in 88 Hours; Tao Praises and Worries
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 9 日消息，OpenAI 于当地时间 9 月 8 日宣布，其内部未公开的 AI 模型（性能远超最新发布的 GPT-6 Astra）已成功解决“纳维-斯托克斯存在性与光滑性问题”（Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem），这是克莱数学研究所（Clay Mathematics Institute）于 2000 年提出的七个“千禧年大奖难题”之一。 该问题关注描述流体运动的纳维-斯托克斯方程是否会失效，已困扰数学界约 90 年。 在此之前，Anthropic 上个月宣布其内部一款未公开的 Claude 研究模型在攻克黎曼猜想的过程中取得重要进展，将黎曼 ζ 函数临界线上零点比例的长期下界从 41.6% 提高到了 67.2%。消息一出，业界震惊。 ▲ 局部不可压缩运动的示意图。橙色表示角旋转速度较快；青色表示角旋转速度较慢。环流速度也取决于半径。轨迹显示出向内螺旋运动和轴向拉伸。 OpenAI 表示，该团队通过让约 10,000 个 AI 智能体协作，在约 88 小时内生成了证明。证明显示，一个初始平滑的静止流体在有限时间内可能发展出“奇点”（singularity），即流速无限增长。 OpenAI 提供了分析证明及 Lean 编程语言的形式化验证。验证工作由 GPT-6 Astra 在约 17 小时内完成。 ▲ Op…
items.summary_en: OpenAI announced on Sept 8 that an unreleased internal model (outperforming GPT-6 Astra) solved the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem, one of the Clay Millennium Problems. A team of about 10,000 AI agents produced a proof in 88 hours, with formal verification completed by GPT-6 Astra via Lean in 17 hours. Mathematician Terence Tao reportedly both praised and worried about the development.
items.why_zh: 这标志着 AI 在高级数学研究中的能力实现重大飞跃，但也引发对 AI 自主科学发现可靠性与人类角色被削弱的担忧。
items.why_en: It marks a major leap in AI's ability to tackle advanced mathematics, while also raising questions about reliability and the human role in discovery.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 9 日消息，除了 iOS / iPadOS 26.6.2 正式版更新之外，苹果同时还为其即将推出的 Beats 360 头戴式耳机推送了固件更新（版本号 4A203）。这意味着产品发布已临近。 近几个月来，Beats 360 已多次出现在监管数据库和零售商的列表中。在今年 6 月举行的 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯期间，足球明星拉明 · 亚马尔（Lamine Yamal）和安东尼 · 罗宾逊（Antonee Robinson）就曾被拍到佩戴这款尚未发布的耳机。 根据此前曝光的信息，Beats 360 在设计上与 AirPods Max 有几分相似，采用了可伸缩的头梁臂。它将提供黑色、云白色、天蓝色和粉色等多种颜色选择，并且耳罩和头带衬垫均可更换。 在核心功能上，Beats 360 支持 ANC 主动降噪，据称其降噪效果可达 Beats Studio Pro（2023 年）的 1.75 倍。此外，它将是苹果首款具备防汗防水能力的头戴式耳机，防护等级为 IPX4。 其他特点包括全天续航、可折叠平放的设计、高保真声学平台，以及支持免提“Siri”语音唤醒功能。包装内将附赠可更换的 Performance Knit 衬垫和便携盒，但 USB-C 充电线和电源适配器需用户自行准备。 售价方面，有零售商列表显示其在美国的定价为 299.99 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合…
items.summary_en: Apple has pushed firmware 4A203 to its unreleased Beats 360 headphones, hinting at an imminent launch. Known details include an AirPods Max-like design, ANC up to 1.75x stronger than Beats Studio Pro, IPX4 sweat/water resistance, all-day battery, foldable build, and a US retail price of $299.99.
items.why_zh: 固件先于产品推送通常意味着发售窗口临近，同时 Beats 360 是苹果布局头戴式耳机的关键新品。
items.why_en: A firmware push before launch signals an imminent release, making Beats 360 a key upcoming Apple audio product.

items.title_zh: OpenAI声称用AI解决困扰90年的Navier-Stokes问题，引发风波
items.title_en: Drama swirls around OpenAI’s legendary mathematical milestone
items.summary_zh: OpenAI表示，其内部一个比新发布的GPT-6 Astra更强大的AI模型，借助10,000个并发智能体，找到了Navier-Stokes问题的解。Navier-Stokes问题与液体和气体流动有关，是近90年未解决的重大数学难题，也是千禧年大奖难题之一，每道题悬赏100万美元。该消息最早由《纽约时报》和《连线》报道，OpenAI在周二博客中正式宣布。这一宣称引发学界和业界的讨论，但其正确性仍有待验证。
items.summary_en: OpenAI says it found a solution to a major math problem that has remained unsolved for around 90 years, as reported earlier by The New York Times and Wired . In a blog post on Tuesday , OpenAI announced that it discovered a solution to the Navier-Stokes problem - which relates to the flow of liquid and gas - using an internal AI model more powerful than the newly released GPT-6 Astra alongside 10,000 concurrent agents. The Navier-Stokes problem is one of seven Millennium Prize Problems , each of which comes with a $1 million reward for solving. OpenAI says it started training the internal AI m…
items.why_zh: 如果属实，这将证明AI可以攻克人类顶尖数学家长期未解的难题，深刻影响科学发现模式。
items.why_en: If true, it would show AI can solve long-standing mathematical problems, potentially transforming scientific discovery.

items.why_en: Muse represents Meta's latest attempt to embed AI into daily routines and compete in the consumer agent space.

Once given a goal, Meta says Muse can work on its own, opening a browser, filling out…

items.summary_zh: Anthropic 曾表示重度用户是其业务核心，会优先满足他们的需求，为此不惜冷落 OpenClaw 等其他热门应用。但一些用户认为 Anthropic 让他们误以为高价订阅能获得远比实际更多的服务。在今天一项扩大的集体诉讼中，一群 Claude 订阅用户指控该公司对其 Max 订阅层级的使用限制进行欺骗性宣传。诉讼由 Monica Vaca 和 Kati Daffan 提起，两人曾在莉娜·汗领导下的美国联邦贸易委员会任职。这一案件反映出 AI 公司订阅宣传与实际服务之间的信任争议。
items.summary_en: Anthropic says power users are key to its business - it's prioritized them even when it means cutting off other popular applications, like OpenClaw. But some of these same customers say Anthropic misled them into believing they'd get more out of a top-tier pricing subscription than they did. In an expanded class action lawsuit filed today, a group of Claude subscribers say the company deceptively advertised the limits of its Max subscription tier. The lawsuit was brought by attorneys Monica Vaca and Kati Daffan, who both formerly worked at the Federal Trade Commission under Lina Khan. It's a r…
items.why_zh: 该案件将检验 AI 公司订阅宣传的真实性，影响行业内定价与用户权益保护。
items.why_en: The lawsuit could test how AI companies advertise subscription tiers and may reshape user-protection standards in the industry.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 研究员被指施压数学家撤回论文上的 Anthropic 联作者
items.title_en: OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper
items.summary_zh: 据 The Decoder 报道，OpenAI 的一名研究员被指控向一位数学家施压，要求该数学家从一篇关于数学突破的论文中撤下与 Anthropic 相关的一位共同作者。目前报道没有提供事件发生的背景与更多细节，尚不清楚施压方式是口头建议还是更强制的要求。这一说法若得到证实，可能反映出主要 AI 实验室之间在研究合作、人才归属等问题上的紧张。事件也提醒科学界注意，论文署名应保持学术独立，而非受商业竞争影响。相关方尚未通过报道给出完整回应。
items.summary_en: OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper the-decoder.com
items.why_zh: 它折射出 AI 实验室之间的人才与成果之争，可能影响未来科研署名公正性。
items.why_en: It underscores rivalry between top AI labs and raises questions about fair authorship in AI-driven science.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT-6 Astra，甲骨文股价应声上涨
items.title_en: Oracle stock rises as OpenAI launches ChatGPT-6 Astra
items.summary_zh: 外媒报道称，在 OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT-6 Astra 后，云计算和数据库公司甲骨文（Oracle）的股价出现上涨。报道并未说明模型的具体技术参数、功能亮点，也未提供股价涨幅等数据；但从标题看，两者被直接关联。市场普遍认为，OpenAI 每隔一段时间发布新模型都会带动对高性能算力和云基础设施的需求，而甲骨文被视作潜在受益方之一。当然，具体关系与影响程度仍需等待后续细节，投资者也应对公司层面合作信号保持关注。
items.summary_en: Oracle stock rises as OpenAI launches ChatGPT-6 Astra qz.com
items.why_zh: OpenAI 的重大发布可能牵动云计算等 AI 基础设施公司的股价，凸显 AI 与资本市场的强联动性。
items.why_en: The news shows how OpenAI releases can reverberate through stock markets, affecting infrastructure suppliers like Oracle.

items.title_zh: OpenEvidence面向临床医生推出4款医疗AI模型
items.title_en: OpenEvidence launches 4 medical AI models for clinicians
items.summary_zh: OpenEvidence公司发布了四款面向临床医生使用的医疗AI模型。这些模型主要面向临床场景，服务于医疗工作者。据MobiHealthNews报道，该消息已经对外公布。目前模型的具体功能和名称未在报道中详述。此次发布反映了医疗AI工具正在加速进入日常临床实践。
items.summary_en: OpenEvidence launches 4 medical AI models for clinicians MobiHealthNews
items.why_zh: 这表明医疗AI产品正在加速细分并直接面向一线临床工作者。
items.why_en: It signals an accelerating trend of AI products tailored for frontline clinical use.

items.title_zh: Anthropic放弃60亿美元收购AI初创公司Decart AI
items.title_en: Anthropic Abandons Proposed $6 Billion Acquisition of AI Startup Decart AI
items.summary_zh: 据悉，Anthropic已放弃拟议中的60亿美元收购AI初创公司Decart AI的交易。该收购若完成，原本可显著扩大Anthropic在AI领域的技术与人才布局。目前报道未透露放弃交易的具体原因，可能涉及监管、财务或战略调整等因素。这一决定意味着Decart AI仍需独立寻求发展资金，也可能影响AI行业并购趋势。Anthropic作为AI大模型领域的重要企业，其战略动向备受关注。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Abandons Proposed $6 Billion Acquisition of AI Startup Decart AI citybiz
items.why_zh: 此举反映AI头部公司在并购扩张上的谨慎态度，可能重塑AI市场格局和投资风向。
items.why_en: The move highlights cautious M&A strategies among leading AI firms and could reshape AI market dynamics.

items.title_zh: OpenAI正式发布GPT-6 Astra：如何试用
items.title_en: OpenAI officially launches GPT-6 Astra: How to try it
items.summary_zh: OpenAI正式推出其新一代模型GPT-6 Astra。该模型被认为是GPT系列的重要升级，或带来更强的性能和多模态能力。报道还介绍了用户如何试用这款模型，包括可用平台和具体方法。不过，OpenAI尚未公布全部技术细节。GPT-6 Astra的发布可能进一步加剧AI大模型领域的竞争，并影响开发者和企业用户的选择。
items.summary_en: OpenAI officially launches GPT-6 Astra: How to try it Mashable
items.why_zh: GPT-6 Astra的发布是AI大模型发展的重要里程碑，直接影响行业竞争格局和用户体验。
items.why_en: The release of GPT-6 Astra marks a major milestone in AI foundation models, reshaping competition and user expectations.

items.title_zh: Ataraxis AI启动ARC大规模前瞻性研究，验证AI预测与肿瘤患者真实结局的关联
items.title_en: Ataraxis AI Launches ARC, a Large-Scale Prospective Study Linking AI Model Predictions to Real Patient Outcomes Across Oncology
items.summary_zh: Ataraxis AI宣布启动一项名为ARC的大规模前瞻性研究，旨在将AI模型的预测与肿瘤学领域患者的真实结局联系起来。该研究有望评估AI在癌症诊疗中的实际临床价值和可靠性。通过收集真实世界数据，ARC可能为AI辅助决策提供更有力的证据。此举标志着AI医疗从理论验证走向临床落地的重要一步，或将影响肿瘤治疗方案的制定标准。
items.summary_en: Ataraxis AI Launches ARC, a Large-Scale Prospective Study Linking AI Model Predictions to Real Patient Outcomes Across Oncology Business Wire
items.why_zh: 该研究是AI在肿瘤临床应用中向真实世界证据迈进的重大尝试，对精准医疗和AI监管具有参考意义。
items.why_en: This study is a major step toward real-world evidence for AI in oncology, informing precision medicine and AI regulatory frameworks.

items.title_zh: Chrome改为每两周更新一次，AI改变安全格局
items.title_en: Chrome is now shipping updates every 2 weeks as AI changes the security landscape
items.summary_zh: 鉴于AI快速改变网络安全格局，Google正加快Chrome的更新节奏，从原先的周期改为每两周发布一次安全补丁和新功能。更频繁的更新有助于及时修复漏洞，应对AI带来的新型威胁。这也反映出在AI时代，浏览器安全和功能迭代需要更高的响应速度。该变化可能影响Web开发者的测试周期和用户的更新体验。
items.summary_en: Google is speeding up Chrome’s release schedule to ship security patches and new features faster.
items.why_zh: 更短的更新周期反映了AI时代对浏览器安全响应速度的新要求，也体现了网络安全环境正在被AI重塑。
items.why_en: The faster update cadence underscores how AI is reshaping cybersecurity, demanding quicker responses from browser vendors.

items.title_zh: OpenEvidence面向临床医生发布四款医学AI模型
items.title_en: OpenEvidence launches four medical AI models for clinicians
items.summary_zh: OpenEvidence宣布推出四款专为临床医生设计的医学AI模型。这些模型可能旨在提供临床决策支持、医学知识检索或患者数据解读等功能。新模型或将帮助医生更高效地获取循证医学信息，减少误诊漏诊风险。目前尚不清楚四个模型各自的具体用途。此举有望进一步推动AI在医疗实践中的渗透，但实际疗效仍需临床验证。
items.summary_en: OpenEvidence launches four medical AI models for clinicians MobiHealthNews
items.why_zh: 这四款医学模型瞄准临床医生核心场景，体现了AI辅助诊疗从通用走向专科细分的趋势。
items.why_en: These clinician-focused models signal a shift toward specialized AI applications in medicine, highlighting AI's growing role in point-of-care support.

items.title_zh: Mistral完成35亿美元融资，创欧洲AI领域纪录
items.title_en: Mistral Raises $3.5 Billion for AI Research in Record EU Funding Round
items.summary_zh: 法国AI公司Mistral宣布在最新一轮融资中筹集35亿美元，用于AI研究。此次融资成为欧盟历史上规模最大的AI融资交易之一。资金将支持其大模型研发和全球化扩展。Mistral持续受到投资者关注，被视为欧洲挑战美国AI巨头的重要力量。这笔巨额资金可能加剧全球AI竞赛，尤其是在大模型领域。
items.summary_en: Mistral Raises $3.5 Billion for AI Research in Record EU Funding Round PYMNTS.com
items.why_zh: 这笔创纪录融资增强了欧洲在AI大模型竞赛中的底气，可能改变全球AI产业格局。
items.why_en: This record funding strengthens Europe's position in the AI race and could balance the global AI competitive landscape.

items.title_zh: 《奇异人生》开发商 Dont Nod 陷财务危机：计划裁员 90 人，可能撑不过明年 1 月
items.title_en: Dont Nod, Maker of 'Life is Strange', Faces Financial Crisis: Plans to Lay Off 90, May Not Survive Past January
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 8 日消息，据游戏媒体 VGC 今天报道，法国游戏工作室 Dont Nod Entertainment 表示，公司可能需要裁员最多 90 人，并警告称公司可能面临关闭局面。 IT之家从原报道获悉，Dont Nod 工作室成立于 2008 年，以《奇异人生》系列游戏而闻名。该公司在 2026 年上半年报告中表示，董事会已批准新商业模式， 可能导致最多 90 人被裁员 。 该公司在声明中表示：“尽管我们已经采取了业绩改善计划，实施一系列削减成本行动，但上述努力不足以恢复长期竞争力。我们正在重新考虑法国业务，将运营重点集中于单一作品，同时整合启动新项目所需的专业能力。” 此外，Dont Nod 今年 4 月推出了新作《Aphelion》，但该作的销量不足以帮助公司摆脱困境。审计机构曾于 6 月警告称，该公司可能会在今年内耗尽资金。 Dont Nod 此前曾于 2020 年向腾讯出售少数股权，但腾讯如今没有计划向公司注资。此次财务报告也谈到了这一问题。公司表示，如果无法尽快获得新的融资， 他们可能无法撑过明年 1 月 31 日 。
items.summary_en: French studio Dont Nod, known for Life is Strange, is in financial trouble. It plans up to 90 layoffs as part of a new business model, and warns it may not survive past January 31 unless new funding is secured. Its latest game Aphelion underperformed, and shareholder Tencent is not planning to invest.
items.why_zh: 知名工作室的生存危机折射出游戏行业创意与商业平衡的困境，也警示依赖单一爆款的高风险。
items.why_en: The crisis at a celebrated studio highlights the fragility of game companies reliant on hit titles and the industry's creative-commercial pressure.
